summary: Tenaris S.A., a Luxembourg-domiciled steel and pipe manufacturer, furnished a Form 6-K containing its unaudited consolidated condensed interim financial statements for the nine-month period ended September 30, 2026. Net sales for the nine months were $9,169.4 million versus $8,986.0 million a year earlier, while operating income slipped to $1,675.4 million from $1,729.3 million. Diluted EPS was $1.51 per share ($3.02 per ADS) for the nine months and $0.50 ($1.01 per ADS) for the third quarter. Weighted average shares fell to 1,009.9 million from 1,064.4 million, implying a continuing buyback program. This is a routine periodic earnings disclosure, not a special situation; no transaction terms, advisors, or board recommendations are involved. There is no deal to arbitrage.
